messages:
Maya (Support): FYI customer acme-inc seeing 400 from /v1/rerank, message: "empty candidates". They send JSON inside a multipart/form-data field called 'payload'.
Anita (SE): Do we parse fields in multipart? I thought rerank expects application/json body.
Maya (Support): Repro from customer (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----WebKitFormBoundary" \
  -F "payload={"items":[{"id":"1","text":"query"}],"candidates":[]}"
```
Maya (Support): Server returns 400 with body: {"error":"invalid_request","message":"empty candidates array"} and x-request-id: req_01GABCXYZ
Jared (Client): That's our bug — RN fetch + FormData used to attach a file; we accidentally wrapped the rerank JSON into a form field. Works when we send raw JSON.
Anita (SE): Ok. Two action items: 1) tell client to send Content-Type: application/json and raw body (quick fix). 2) decide if server should try to parse a 'payload' form field when receiving multipart (P2).
Maya (Support): Customer asks if we can accept this format — they can't change client immediately. Requesting temporary leniency.
Anita (SE): Parsing it server-side is doable but risky (could accept unintended payloads). I'll file an eng ticket to evaluate (RED-1134).
Maya (Support): Added ticket and pinged eng-backend; linked req id req_01GABCXYZ. Marking support case as escalated.
infra-bot: New ticket created: RED-1134 — backend: consider parsing multipart 'payload' field as JSON for rerank endpoint.
Jared (Client): Thanks, we can roll a fix on our side but would appreciate backend fallback in case other clients hit this. :thumbsup:
Maya (Support): Sending customer repro steps and suggested curl to workaround. Closing interim support loop, will update when RED-1134 gets an ETA.
